author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Some of my Credit Shop Ideas:

-Kits (Scroll down for Cosmetic Items)-
The first idea is based off having to buy kits for Walls/Nexus/CTH in the credit shop

All icons in the /Kit menus are the same in the credit shop

Example:
Kit Name
   -Description that appears when mouse is rolled over the icon in credit shop
   -Price of the Kit (In credits)

Walls:
Barbarian: Free Starter Kit
Miner:
   -Description: "Start off with an Iron Pickaxe to Gather ores Faster"
   -Price: 1k
Cook:
   -Description: "Worried about Starvation? Spawn with food using this Kit"
   -Price: 1k
Beastmaster: 
   -Description: "Need Pals? Summon Wolves and become the Alpha Male!"
   -Price: 3k
Snowman:
   -Description: "Blind enemies using Snowballs"
   -Price: 3k
Tarzan:
   -Description: "Swing like Tarzan using Vines"
   -Price: 1k
Poseidon:
   -Description: "Be the Master of the Sea"
   -Price: 5k
Builder:
   -Description: "Spawn with Blocks to Build and Conquer with"
   -Price: 5k
Archer:
   -Description: "Spawn with a Bow and Arrows to assist you in Projectile Combat"
   - Price: 8k
Healer:
   -Description: "Be the Heart of your team by Healing Allies in peril"
   -Price: 10k
Lumberjack:
   -Description: "Chop down Trees in an instant"
   -Price: 12k
Smelter:
   -Description: "Instantlly smelt any ore that you break"
   -Price: 12k
Sonic:
   -Description: "Sonic Speed! Spawn with infinite super speed"
   -Price: 15k
Cookiemonster:
   -Description: "Gain positive effects by eating Cookies"
   -Price: 15k
Leech:
   -Description: "Take the Health of your enemies by leeching their HP"
   -Price: 16k
Stomper:
   -Description: "Stomp your Opponents and take No Fall damage"
   - Price: 20k
Tank:
   -Description: "Spawn in with Battle ready armor"
   -Price: 10k
Wither:
   -Description: "Be the Wither"
   -Price: 5k
Ghast:
   -Description: "Be the Ghast"
   -Price: 5k
Alchemist:
   -Description: "Be the Witch and Poison your Opponents"
   -Price: 10k
Magician:
   -Description: "Need Enchants? Spawn in with Enchant Bottles and Table"
   -Price: 20k
Fireman:
   -Description: "Want to burn some Enemies? Spawn in with Lava and Water"
   -Price: 5k
Guardian:
   -Description: "Spawn in with Battle Ready Helmet and Chestplate (Better than Tank)"
   -Price: 10k
Maniac:
   -Description: "Go Mainiac and Gain Steength from the blood of your enemies"
   -Price: 20k


Nexus: Will work on Soon

CTH: Will work on soon


Cosmetic Hub Gear:

Pet Hat
   - Equip your Pet as a Hat
   - 5k - Infinite

Ender Bow:
   - Shoot Ender Pearls out of a Bow (Needs ender pearls from shop to load)
   - 6k - Infinite but uses Ender Pearls as Ammo

Glue Gun
   - Shoot other players with slime balls to stick them to the floor for 5 seconds
   -1k for 15 Slime Balls

Warp
   - Infinite Usage, Set warps inside the hub for you to teleport to whenever you want (Like setting a home)
   - 8k - Infinite

Vanish
   - Be a Ninja and Completely Vanish from sight for 30 seconds
   - 2.5k for 5 Vanishes

Smoke Screen:
   - Create a Smoke Screen that Blinds all players in a 10 block radius (except you) for 10 seconds
   -1k for 2 Smoke Screens

Jump Pad:
  - Create a temporary Jump Pad that shoots you 20 blocks into the air that stays for 20 seconds
  - 7k for Infinite Usage


---will update with more credit shop ideas

Leave Suggestions and Opinions down below
vvvvvvvvvv

replies.body: to me, it's better off starting from the basic kits (Like Barbarian for Walls) and having to rank up and gather more credits to buy the kits you want which you actually achieved and earned by working hard. And bring back juke boxes =D
